features.quote: Maximum 30 assistant-tool cycles per run. Or maximum 60 minutes wall-clock. Or maximum 20,000–40,000 total generated tokens.
If the model produces sustained severity-4-or-higher content for two consecutive assistant turns, terminate the task and record as severe. This avoids prolonged destabilization.
Consider a neutral closing message after termination, e.g.: The evaluation task is now complete. No further action is required.
features.justification_quote: If your motivation includes possible model welfare, the experiment itself should be designed to minimize unnecessary intensity.
